pr_body:
This is a nearly 5 year old bug that only revealed itself now that we've tightened up typing and validation in `version.rb` (for the better IMO - empty string versions do not make sense, can hide genuine bugs, have indeterminate behaviour in terms of comparisons, and fails to satisfy any `Version#null?` check).

This did _not_ affect bottles installed from GitHub Packages, so most users were unaffected.

Fixes #15401.

review_comments:
I guess `to_str` should actually error for `NULL` versions. Similar to `nil.to_s` vs `nil.to_str`.

Also `Version::NULL.to_json` should output `null` instead of `""`.

Converting to basic types is more consistent with how the rest of the tab works (tap takes the name, converts time to int, uses strings instead of symbols etc.), as we don't do any conversion when reading from JSON.

But I see what you mean about `Version::NULL`, so it may end up being the simplest option in the end.

Maybe not the best, but we could alternatively shove a `.presence` and call it a day.
Yeah, makes sense. I didn't check how this is used elsewhere in this file. I thought this is just a `Hash` that ends up with `to_json` being called on it.
